1. **`grouping_tier_bitmask` was never computed** — the original filtered/ordered by a nonexistent column. Fixed by adding `F.grouping_id(...)` to the aggregation (with the same argument order as the SQL, since it determines the bit positions).

5. Removed the bogus unused windows (`w5`, `w6`).
6. Kept exact semantics elsewhere: timestamp−timestamp interval comparison for the 15-minute gap test, `rangeBetween(-300, currentRow)` over epoch seconds for the sliding window, and `intersectAll` for bag-semantics `INTERSECT ALL` (which matches columns by position, like SQL set ops).

        F.regexp_extract("raw_symbol", "^([A-Z]{3,5})[/-]([A-Z]{3,5})$", 2).alias("quote_asset"),

        F.col("execution_details")["quantity"].try_cast("double").alias("quantity"),
        F.zip_with("fee_tier_rates", "applicable_multipliers", lambda rate, mult: F.round(rate * mult, 6)).alias("computed_fee_schedule"),
        F.aggregate(
            "fee_tier_rates",
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, rate: acc + (rate * F.col("execution_details")["quantity"].try_cast("double")),

w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("trade_timestamp")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("trade_timestamp").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_account_burst = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "burst_island_id").orderBy("trade_timestamp")
w_sliding_5m = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "burst_island_id").orderBy(F.col("trade_timestamp").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-300, Window.currentRow)

parsed_executions = (
    df_trade_stream
    .filter((F.col("trade_timestamp") >= F.lit("2026-06-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("execution_details").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "trade_id",
        "account_id",
        "trade_timestamp",
        F.regexp_extract("raw_symbol", "^([A-Z]{3,5})[/-]([A-Z]{3,5})$", 1).alias("base_asset"),
        F.regexp_extract("raw_symbol", "^([A-Z]{3,5})[/-]([A-Z]{3,5})$", 2).alias("quote_asset"),
        F.col("execution_details")["fill_price"].try_cast("double").alias("fill_price"),
        F.col("execution_details")["quantity"].try_cast("double").alias("quantity"),
        F.zip_with("fee_tier_rates", "applicable_multipliers", lambda rate, mult: F.round(rate * mult, 6)).alias("computed_fee_schedule"),
        F.aggregate(
            "fee_tier_rates",
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, rate: acc + (rate * F.col("execution_details")["quantity"].try_cast("double")),
            lambda acc: F.round(acc, 4),
        ).alias("total_execution_fee"),
    )
)

gaps_and_islands = (
    parsed_executions
    .filter((F.col("fill_price") > 0.0) & (F.col("quantity") > 0.0))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("trade_timestamp") - F.lag("trade_timestamp", 1).over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_new_burst"),
    )
)

sessionized_bursts = (
    gaps_and_islands
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("burst_island_id"),
    )
)

statistical_profiles = (
    sessionized_bursts
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "burst_island_id",
        "base_asset",
        "quote_asset",
        "trade_timestamp",
        "fill_price",
        "quantity",
        "total_execution_fee",
        ((F.col("fill_price") * F.col("quantity")) - F.col("total_execution_fee")).alias("net_consideration"),
        F.stddev_samp("fill_price").over(w_account_burst).alias("burst_price_stddev"),
        F.corr("fill_price", "quantity").over(w_account_burst).alias("price_volume_correlation"),
        F.max("fill_price").over(w_sliding_5m).alias("burst_high_watermark"),
    )
)

verified_settlements = (
    statistical_profiles
    .select("account_id", "burst_island_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_cleared_settlement_batches
        .select("account_id", "burst_island_id")
    )
)

joined = (
    statistical_profiles.alias("sp")
    .join(
        verified_settlements.alias("vs"),
        (F.col("sp.account_id") == F.col("vs.account_id")) & (F.col("sp.burst_island_id") == F.col("vs.burst_island_id")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select("sp.*")
    .withColumn(
        "volatility_cluster",
        F.when(F.col("burst_price_stddev").isNull() | (F.col("burst_price_stddev") == 0.0), "STABLE")
         .when(F.col("burst_price_stddev") > 5.0, "HIGH_VOLATILITY")
         .otherwise("NORMAL"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .cube("base_asset", "quote_asset", "volatility_cluster")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id("base_asset", "quote_asset", "volatility_cluster").alias("grouping_tier_bitmask"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("total_trades"),
        F.round(F.sum("net_consideration"), 2).alias("aggregate_net_turnover"),
        F.avg(F.coalesce(F.col("price_volume_correlation"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("avg_batch_correlation"),
        F.percentile_approx("net_consideration", [0.05, 0.5, 0.95], 1000).alias("pnl_distribution_quantiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("grouping_tier_bitmask") < 7)
    .select(
        "base_asset",
        "quote_asset",
        "volatility_cluster",
        "grouping_tier_bitmask",
        "total_trades",
        "aggregate_net_turnover",
        "avg_batch_correlation",
        "pnl_distribution_quantiles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("grouping_tier_bitmask").asc(), F.col("aggregate_net_turnover").desc_nulls_last())
)
